summary: Temporal's pgx v5.9.2 dependency is vulnerable to authentication downgrade attacks (CWE-306) where a malicious PostgreSQL server can force cleartext password authentication. The fix requires updating to pgx v5.10.0+ which adds a require_auth configuration option to restrict accepted authentication methods.
userImpact: Temporal deployments using PostgreSQL are vulnerable to credential downgrade attacks from malicious or compromised servers until pgx is upgraded.
rootCause: pgx < v5.10.0 unconditionally accepts AuthenticationCleartextPassword without configuration to restrict authentication methods.
proposedFix: Upgrade github.com/jackc/pgx/v5 to v5.10.0 or later which implements require_auth config option.
keyQuote: A malicious PostgreSQL server can downgrade authentication to cleartext password by sending AuthenticationCleartextPassword, which pgx < v5.10.0 accepts unconditionally.
